verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a local API and an official MCP server (@anyproto/anytype-mcp) that fronts that API, allowing AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, etc. to read, search, and modify Objects entirely headlessly without touching the GUI, and this was verified at runtime to actually launch and connect. The OpenAPI spec (22 paths) confirms concrete read/write endpoints beyond marketing claims. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-vendor) hands-on report confirming write operations succeed end-to-end via the MCP server.
